mapper.sql: select provider_id, name, slug, site_url, logo_url, region, source, enabled, sort, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from km_provider
mapper.select: where enabled = '0' order by sort asc, provider_id asc

select p.provider_id from km_provider p join km_media_release r on r.source = 'custom' and r.platform = p.name and r.media_id = #{mediaId} group by p.provider_id, p.sort order by p.sort asc, p.provider_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into km_provider (name, slug, site_url, logo_url, region, source, enabled, sort, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{name}, #{slug}, #{siteUrl}, #{logoUrl}, #{region}, ifnull(#{source},'custom'), ifnull(#{enabled},'0'), ifnull(#{sort},0), #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from km_provider where provider_id in #{id}
